name: lab-support-bridge
description: Receive LAB questions from customers, staff and admins; return role-scoped replies through the authenticated support bridge.

interface.longDescription: Support signed-in LAB customers, staff and admins using current role-scoped data. Receive question events, read current context, and publish concise verified partial or final answers. This plugin cannot change bookings, payments, accounts or maintenance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start LAB customer support in Work/Cloud: subscribe to lab.assistant.question.created, read each question context, check relevant current customer data, and publish the grounded answer to LAB.
